overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Kafka log subscription uses Vector on a managed node to consume external Kafka topics and forward events onto the existing NATS path. Use it when a third-party system can only write to Kafka and the platform does not run an embedded Kafka cluster. This is different from the Kafka collect type, which reads Kafka broker log files.

items.title: External topic subscription
items.description: Consume the customer Kafka as a client. The platform does not deploy Kafka.

items.title: Optional authentication
items.description: Supports PLAIN / SCRAM SASL and a TLS switch for typical secured clusters

items.title: Consumer group isolation
items.description: Set a consumer group, or leave it empty to use bk-lite-<instance ID> and avoid stealing existing consumers

items.title: Existing ingest path
items.description: Events go to NATS subject vector, then search, extractors, and alerts reuse the current log pipeline

bestPractices.title: Access notes
items: Bind a managed node that can reach Kafka advertised.listeners
First attach starts from latest by default to avoid replaying historical partitions
The same group on multiple nodes shares partitions; different groups duplicate consumption
Payloads are stored in message; use log extractors for further structured parsing
